public_diagnostic.requirement: List EVERY id in the CURRENT Request's /available_actions, exactly once: set(candidate_action_ids) equals the set of all current available Action ids, and len(candidate_action_ids) equals len(set(candidate_action_ids)). This is the full available list, NOT just the selected Action, your considered subset, or one obligation's alternatives. Do not use an initial or previous State's list. Newly enabled Actions may appear after Claim acceptance; the list need not only shrink. Any permutation of this ID list is permitted. Only this field uses unordered set equality.
